summary_md: **David Duong ([@DDuongTech](https://x.com/DDuongTech/status/2115784515742244881))** summarizes **llama.cpp v0.8.0**: LiquidAI LFM3 support across text, vision, audio and omni, realtime audio via /v1/realtime and /tts, new architectures including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Muse Spark, Hugging Face Hub browsing in the web UI, and ggml v0.28.0 ([llama.cpp releases](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag)).
relevance: Core local-inference runtime update with new model support.
